min_version_code.description: Builds with a lower version code (number after + in pubspec.yaml) must update: blocking dialog.

latest_version_code.description: Builds with a lower version code are offered an optional update (asked once per release).

update_message.description: Optional custom update text. Empty = translated default. Add conditions per device language for other languages.

update_url.description: Optional store link for the update button. Empty = Google Play page of the app.

ai_enabled.description: Shows the AI assistant. Turn on after enabling Firebase AI Logic (see docs/AI_SETUP.md).

ai_provider.description: gemini = free Gemini via Firebase AI Logic; worker = Claude via server/ai-worker (paid).

ai_model.description: Gemini model used when ai_provider = gemini.

ai_endpoint.description: Worker URL used when ai_provider = worker.
